description: Credit weighted GPA on the 4.0 scale using the page grade points: A+ and A 4.0, A- 3.7, B+ 3.3, B 3.0, B- 2.7, C+ 2.3, C 2.0, C- 1.7, D+ 1.3, D 1.0, F 0.0. Grades and credits are matched by position. Use when the user computes a GPA from course grades and credits. To plan grades for a target GPA use calculate_gpa_planner. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive GPA calculator.
